name: BF Utilities Ltd
description: AboutIncorporated in 2000, BF Utilities Ltd is engaged in the generation of electricity through wind mills and Infrastructure  activities.[1]Key PointsCompany Overview[1]BF Utilities Ltd. (BFUL), part of the USD 3 billion Kalyani Group, originated from a demerger of Bharat Forge Ltd., approved by the Bombay High Court in January 2001. Under the scheme, investment holdings and the windmills division were transferred to BFUL, with shareholders receiving one BFUL equity share (₹5) for every Bharat Forge share (₹10) held. The company has since restructured through a Composite Scheme of Arrangement, retaining its Infrastructure Business while transferring the Investment Business to BF Investment Ltd.Read MoreWebsiteBSENSE
